title: Sectionlab
summary: This visual holds the data of Sectionlab. Its page is now the notebook play/sectionlab/ of yujieteo/site. The notebook builds a cross-section from library shapes and calculates its section properties, its torsion constant and its Ramberg–Osgood moment–curvature curve with a Rust solver. raw.json holds 9 example sections, 4 library materials, the notice, the method, the conventions, the assumptions and the sources. reference/ holds the frozen answers of the Python references: 30 cases with their closed-form values, their section properties and their moment–curvature points, and the measured accuracy of 9 torsion formulas.
